pricing_basis: Recorded usage priced by existing pipeline rates at 200 JPY/USD; not a reconciled provider invoice.

findings.finding: Two audit attempts with one repair; newly found defects in audit 2 have no automatic repair opportunity.
Every changed article currently receives all five whole-article reviewer roles.

The two-block prose request contains 12149 system-prompt characters versus 543 serialized article-block characters. Source-document selection is already empty; fixed repair instructions dominate this small request.

proposal_not_implemented.design: Use the existing repair and audit machinery; route by actual edit scope rather than adding a new agent or always repeating five checks.
proposal_not_implemented.primary_change: Select existing repair instructions needed for prose-only fixes; retain immutable facts/conditions, links, headings, CTA and user style constraints. Do not copy fact-acquisition instructions into purely grammatical repairs.
proposal_not_implemented.completion_rule: At most one bounded final local correction when full re-audit has passed all non-prose criteria and remaining failures are locally addressable prose defects. Otherwise keep existing unresolved result.
proposal_not_implemented.local_validation: Check the exact diff, neighboring text, attribution, negation, conditions, and meaning; then run whole-article deterministic structure, length and CTA checks. Existing repair schema and block-address enforcement remain in use.
proposal_not_implemented.eligibility: Not inferred merely from key=prose_quality or unchanged numbers. Recommendation strength, benefit/guarantee scope, fact/condition changes, headings/tables, deletions, and unresolved research exclude this narrow route.
proposal_not_implemented.prior_pass_handling: No copying a full-article pass across snapshots. Store prior audited snapshot plus exact patch and scoped validation as an explicit result lineage; update completion checks to understand that evidence before enabling this route.
proposal_not_implemented.budget: Shared article budget and durable call counters; no increased default cap or automatic reattempt if local correction fails. Insufficient balance preserves readable output with confirmation incomplete.
proposal_not_implemented.expected_cost_effect: Avoid another approximately 66 JPY five-role re-audit for a qualifying final prose correction. Replacement repair/check cost is unmeasured; no claimed net savings or <=300 JPY end-to-end guarantee.
free_validation_before_paid_test: Regression fixtures for grammar and sentence splitting across different product categories.
Reject changed negation, attribution, pricing periods, fact qualifiers, unsupported benefit claims and out-of-scope block edits.
Keep empathy, relevant conditions, headings, tables and CTA stable.
Verify bounded attempts survive restart, use shared remaining budget, and failed scoped checks cannot promote completion.

next_step: Implement the narrow scope routing and acceptance lineage on the test branch after agreement; finish offline checks before requesting a paid test.
